title: Canonical residue extension of a restricted valuation ring
statement: Let $K,L$ be fields [def-weil-field], let $f:K\to L$ be a field embedding, and let $O\subseteq L$ be a valuation subring (a subring containing $x$ or $x^{-1}$ for every nonzero $x\in L$). Define $R=f^{-1}(O)$. The restriction $i:R\to O$, $r\mapsto f(r)$, is local: it reflects units. Define the canonical residue-field embedding $\bar i:\kappa(R)\to\kappa(O)$ by $\bar i([r])=[f(r)]$, where the residue fields [def-weil-residue-field] are the quotients by the maximal ideals (equivalently, the residue fields at the closed points of their spectra). The residue extension algebra structure on $\kappa(O)$ over $\kappa(R)$ is the one induced by $\bar i$.

source.place: §2.1, extension of valued fields and residue fields; Proposition 4.3.1 proof, first stage, p. 28. Canonical restriction and induced residue extension.
